messages:
sam: Quick Qtr OKR mini-check: inference-telemetry rollout status — what shipped, what slipped, owners, next steps? please reply with 1-2 line updates by EOD.

ash: Shipped: telemetry schema + ingestion for Hosted API; docs PR #342 merged; canary started yesterday, basic metrics flowing. Noted a couple of partial disconnects in canary nodes.

devon: Owner for rollout infra: devon + lena. Observed network flakiness causing retries to spike. Plan: increase connection pool timeout + add exponential retry cap. Will open infra PR tomorrow (349).

lena: Eng-infra update: added timeout patch locally, staging tests green for 10k events/min. PR #351 opened, needs review. Dedicated tests scheduled Tue.

ash: CR ping @lena on #351 and @devon on #349 — please prioritize so we can proceed with broader canary. Also product signoff needed on schema rename.

maya: Product: schema is fine overall. One small rename request: event_type -> telemetry_event_type for clarity. Not blocking rollout; I'll file a tiny followup doc. :+1:

devon: Tentative rollout plan: infra patch deploy Wed, bump canary to 10% Thu, global Fri if no regressions. Will call a freeze if we see >2% error spike.

ash: Slip to note: embedding-caching optimization we scoped for this quarter is blocked by KV-store upgrade. Moving that to next quarter. Owner stays ash; will update OKR doc.

sam: Noted dependency. Action items summary: (1) devon/lena push infra PRs (349/351) (2) ash to replan embedding optimization + update OKR doc (3) maya confirm schema rename in docs. I'll update milestone board after EOD updates.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started: canary-id=c-2026-03-18-71 rolling to 4 nodes.

ash: ACK deploying. I'll tail logs: `kubectl logs -l app=telemetry -n canary | grep ERROR` and report anomalies.

devon: CRs are small; left one inline suggestion for retry backoff. @ash please take a look before merge.

lena: Will address comment and push patch. Also proposal: quick postmortem template if canary fails — saves time. @sam can you assign SLO/alert owner?

sam: Assigned alert owner to maya. I'll open a support ticket if we escalate.

ash: Quick check — anyone blocking the Wed deploy? If not, I'll mark milestone as "on-track with infra dependency" and monitor.

maya: No product blockers. Thanks all.

devon: No engineering blockers from my side. Will update if something changes.

ash: Thanks team — will follow up with updated milestone card and links to PRs/CI once merges happen. :rocket:
